newsitem.title: ITALY: Falling CPI will help Italian rates - Industry Min.
newsitem.headline: Falling CPI will help Italian rates - Industry Min.

text.p: Falling inflation will have a positive knock-on effect on interest rates, Italian Industry Minister Pierluigi Bersani said on Friday.

"I believe it is possible to have (annual) inflation at 2.9-3.0 percent by the end of the year...and I envisage a period in the not-too-distant future when falling inflation will be reflected by falling rates," Bersani said.
Earlier on Friday, statistics office Istat said inflation in September was 3.4 percent year-on-year.
Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said recently that inflation would have to fall to under three percent before official interest rates could be cut again.
